title: 第25章 权力的基石第26章 占星术
slug: 军事公主不会爱上魔法科学家
lines: 公爵府门前的石阶冰冷刺骨，跪在上面的几十名商人却汗流浃背。
瑟薇娅根本没有露面。
出来的是财政官格雷森。
格雷森俯视着这群不久前还想扼住北境咽喉的商人们，表情没有一丝波澜。
他展开一张羊皮纸，用一种宣读判决的语调开口。
“公主殿下有令。”
“黄金狮鹫商会为北境带来的所有物资，由公爵府统一采购，再以市场价七成的价格，面向所有北境领民销售，由你们，在场的诸位，负责分销网络，不得有误。”
“其次，即日起，成立北境联合税务稽查队，将对各位名下的所有产业、田地、矿产进行重新估值，并依据新税法补缴过去三年的税款。”
“噗通。”
有商人直接瘫软在地，昏了过去。
补缴三年？按那个要了血命的新税法？那不是补税，那是抄家！
“各位，可以起来了。”格雷森收起羊皮纸，“记住，在北境，谁才是主人。”
书房内，瑟薇娅站在巨大的落地窗前，看着凛冬港的方向。
即使隔着这么远，她仿佛也能看到那三支悬挂着黄金狮鹫旗帜的庞大舰队，它们像三座移动的山脉，彻底镇住了这片土地。
洛加里斯的人情，比她想象中更值钱。
但瑟薇娅很清楚，外力终究是外力。
黄金狮鹫能镇住北境的商人一次，但不可能永远停留在凛冬港。
她需要建立一套真正属于自己的，能够高效运转的权力体系。
“格雷森。”
瑟薇娅开口，声音不大，却透着一股不容置喙的力量。
一直躬身站在她身后的格雷森立刻上前一步：“殿下。”
“你那两个助手，表现不错。”瑟薇娅转过身，银灰色的眼眸盯着他，“一个叫马丁，一个叫科林，对吗？”
格雷森心中一紧，没想到公主殿下连他助手的名字都记得。
“是的，殿下。他们在核算七大家族资产和制定新税法细则时，出了大力。”
“让他们进来。”
很快，两个穿着普通文员服饰的中年男人被带了进来，他们显得局促不安，连头都不敢抬。
瑟薇娅没有废话，直接问道：“马丁，如果现在让你负责凛冬城的商业税收，你准备从哪里开始？”
被点到名的马丁身体一抖，紧张地咽了口唾沫，但还是条理清晰地回答：“回殿下，我会先从与黄金狮鹫商会对接销售网络开始，强制所有商铺使用公爵府统一印发的账本，并派驻税务员监督，杜绝做假账的可能。其次，对奢侈品交易加收三成特别税……”
瑟薇娅又看向另一个人：“科林，一千万金狮币的现金，如果由你来规划，如何保证它在支持工业园区的同时，还能撬动整个北境的经济？”
科林显然比马丁更镇定一些，他思索片刻，沉声回答：“殿下，我会建议成立北境建设银行。用这笔钱作为储备金，向有潜力的工坊主和农场主发放低息贷款，支持他们扩大生产。这样一来，钱能生钱，还能盘活整个民间的活力……”
瑟薇娅听完，脸上露出一抹淡淡的笑意。
“很好。”
她看向格雷森：“从今天起，你正式担任北境财政总管。马丁出任税务部首席次官，科林出任商业部首席次官。我给你们权力，你们给我结果。”
三人同时愣住，随即被巨大的狂喜淹没。
他们跪倒在地，声音都在发颤：“誓死为殿下效忠！”
这是第一步，提拔实干派。
紧接着，瑟薇娅发出了几封请柬。
当晚，公爵府举行了一场小规模的宴会。被邀请的，是几个在之前血洗风波中保持中立，甚至被马库斯等家族打压的旧贵族。
宴会的气氛有些凝重，几位家主坐立不安。
content_en:
The stone steps in front of the Duke's Palace were bone-chilling, but the dozens of businessmen kneeling on them were sweating profusely.
Serviya didn't show up at all.
Out came Financial Officer Grayson.
Grayson looked down at this group of businessmen who wanted to strangle the North Territory not long ago, with no emotion on his expression.
He unfolded a piece of parchment and spoke in the tone of someone pronouncing a verdict.
"Her Royal Highness the Princess has an order."
"All the supplies brought by the Golden Griffin Chamber of Commerce to the Northern Territory will be purchased by the Duke's Palace, and then sold to all Northern Territory citizens at 70% of the market price. You, everyone present, will be responsible for the distribution network without any mistakes."
"Secondly, from now on, a Northern Joint Tax Inspection Team will be established to revalue all properties, fields, and minerals under your name, and pay back taxes for the past three years in accordance with the new tax law."
"Plop."
One businessman collapsed to the ground and fainted.
Three years of back payment? That new tax law that’s going to kill you? That's not tax repayment, that's house confiscation!
"Everyone, you can get up." Grayson put away the parchment, "Remember, who is the master in the North."
…
In the study, Serviya stood in front of the huge floor-to-ceiling window, looking in the direction of Winter Harbor.
Even from such a distance, she seemed to be able to see the three huge fleets flying the golden gryphon flags. They were like three moving mountains, completely controlling the land.
Logaris' favor was more valuable than she imagined.
But Sylvia knows very well that external forces are external forces after all.
The golden griffon can suppress the merchants in the north once, but it cannot stay in Winter Harbor forever.
She needs to establish a power system that is truly her own and can operate efficiently.
"Grayson."
Serviya spoke, her voice was not loud, but it contained an undeniable power.
Grayson, who had been standing behind her with a bow, immediately took a step forward: "Your Highness."
"Your two assistants performed well." Sylvia turned around and stared at him with her silver-grey eyes, "One is named Martin and the other is named Colin, right?"
Grayson's heart tightened. He didn't expect Her Royal Highness to even remember his assistant's name.
"Yes, Your Highness. They have made great efforts in calculating the assets of the seven major families and formulating the details of the new tax law."
"Let them in."
Soon, two middle-aged men wearing ordinary clerk's clothing were brought in. They seemed embarrassed and did not even dare to raise their heads.
Serviya didn't waste any time and asked directly: "Martin, if you are now responsible for the commercial taxation of Winter City, where are you going to start?"
Martin's body trembled when his name was called, and he swallowed nervously, but he still answered clearly and coherently: "Back to Your Highness, I will start by connecting the sales network with the Golden Griffin Chamber of Commerce, forcing all shops to use the account books uniformly issued by the Duke's Palace, and dispatching tax officers to supervise, and eliminate the possibility of false accounting. Secondly, a 30% special tax will be levied on luxury goods transactions..."
Serviya looked at another person: "Colin, if you plan the cash of 10 million gold lion coins, how can you ensure that it can not only support the industrial park, but also leverage the entire northern economy?"
Colin was obviously calmer than Martin. He thought for a moment and replied in a deep voice: "Your Highness, I would suggest the establishment of the Northern Construction Bank. Use this money as a reserve to issue low-interest loans to potential workshop owners and farmers to support them in expanding production. In this way, money can make money and revitalize the vitality of the entire civil society..."
After hearing this, Serviya had a faint smile on her face.
"Very good."
She looked at Grayson: "From today on, you will officially serve as the financial controller of the Northern Territory. Martin will become the Chief Undersecretary of the Department of Taxation, and Colin will become the Chief Undersecretary of the Department of Commerce. I will give you the power, and you will give me the results."
The three of them were stunned at the same time, and were immediately overwhelmed by huge ecstasy.
They knelt on the ground, their voices trembling: "Swear to serve His Highness to the death!"
This is the first step, to promote doers.
Immediately afterwards, Serviya sent out several invitations.
That night, a small banquet was held at the Duke's Palace. Those invited were several old nobles who had remained neutral in the previous bloodbath and were even suppressed by Marcus and other families.
The atmosphere of the banquet was a bit solemn, and several family heads were restless.
